subject: Aligning on HelixCare bespoke retention schedule and wipe cadence
messages:
From: Angela Morris <angela.morris@helixcare.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helixcare.com, security@helixcare.com
Date: 2026-08-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on retention schedule in draft SLA

Vanessa —

Thanks for sending the draft SLA and the proposed retention windows. Our security and procurement teams reviewed the document and have a handful of clarifying questions before we move to signature. Key items:

- We need explicit wipe timelines per data class (PII, logs, model inputs, derived embeddings). The draft has a single "30/90/180" line that doesn't map to our internal retention policy.
- Do you provide an auditable certificate of deletion when data is purged? If so, what's the lead time?
- For data subject requests, what is the SLA to confirm deletion has completed end-to-end?

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our target windows and reasoning (helixcare-retention-questions.xlsx). Can we align on bespoke windows for the pilot? We expect a combination of short-lived session logs and long-term billing records.

Really appreciate a concise mapping back to the order form line items so procurement can approve.

Best,
Angela Morris
Head of Security, HelixCare

---
Attachments: helixcare-retention-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@helixcare.com
Date: 2026-08-30T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention schedule in draft SLA

Hi Angela —

Thanks for the clear spreadsheet. Wanted to respond with concrete, bespoke options that match HelixCare's classes. Attaching our suggested mapping and a minimally-redlined order form (SLA-orderform-draft-83491.docx, helixcare-retention-proposal-v2.pdf).

Summary (proposal):
- Session logs (non-PII telemetry): configurable ephemeral window — default 14 days; optional 7/30 day tiers. We can commit to automated wipe after the selected window.
- Model inputs (records submitted to inference): default retention 90 days unless customer selects immediate purge on ingestion; pilot request: 30-day window.
- Derived embeddings/feature artifacts: retained per customer selection — options: 30 days / 180 days / 7 years (legal hold). For HelixCare pilot we suggest: embeddings=180 days.
- Billing/exec records: 7 years (to satisfy audit/compliance).

Deletion certification and evidence:
- Redwood will emit a deletion event log and a machine-signed deletion certificate (PDF) within 10 business days of completion upon customer request. That certificate will list object identifiers and timestamps.
- For automated purges, we provide a pre-purge notification webhook (48 hours) and a post-purge webhook plus cert if requested.
- For customers that require on-prem deletion verification, we support a customer-run verification hook (details in attached).

Order form language we propose to add (short):
"Customer may select bespoke retention windows per data class at order form execution. Redwood will perform purges per the selected windows and, upon request, provide deletion certification within 10 business days. Exceptions for legal hold must be documented and will be honored until release."

Open items for you:
1) Are the proposed windows above acceptable for the pilot (session logs 14d, inputs 30d, embeddings 180d, billing 7y)?
2) Do you need the deletion certificate to include hashed object IDs or is a registry listing sufficient?
3) Any additional SLA on time-to-cert (we propose 10 business days; can compress to 5 for enterprise add-on).

I can hop on a quick 20-min call if that's faster.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

Angela —

Quick commercial note from our side: if HelixCare confirms the pilot windows (14/30/180/7y), we'll reflect those as order form line items with associated pricing tiers. Shorter windows (e.g., 7d) for session logs would move the workload into higher-cost ephemeral storage with a modest uplift (~5-8%).

Also, the deletion certificate within 10 business days is included in standard enterprise support; if you need guaranteed 5-business-day certs we can include that as a commercial add-on in the order form (outlined in SLA-orderform-draft-83491.docx).

If procurement needs a clear mapping (line-by-line) I can produce a one-page exhibit for signature.

Karthik

Vanessa/Karthik —

Appreciate the detail. A couple follow-ups from our side after an initial review:

- For the deletion certificate we need an auditable hash (SHA-256) of the object IDs so our side can verify integrity. Is that possible?
- For the pre-purge webhook: can you provide an option to pause purge for up to 5 business days while we triage any potential DSARs? We want a deterministic pause window that is easy to operationalize.
- Regarding KV caches: if you do prefix caching for inference acceleration, are keys removed in the same purge as the primary object store? We need assurance there is no lingering copy in the serving layer.

Happy to take a short call to confirm the technical details. If you can update the order form language to explicitly mention SHA-256 listing and the 5-business-day pause option, that would be great.

Thanks —
HelixCare Security Team

Hi all —

Following the thread, legal/CS reviewed the requests and suggested the following concise clause to add to the order form / SLA exhibit:

"Data retention and purge. Customer shall select retention windows per data class at order execution. Redwood shall execute purges in accordance with the selected windows and provide, upon Customer request, a deletion certificate within ten (10) business days containing object identifiers and SHA-256 hashes for verification. Customer may request a single purge pause of up to five (5) business days for investigation; requests must be submitted to Redwood security@redwoodinference.com and include a justification. Exceptions for legal hold shall be documented in writing and take precedence until released by Customer."

Operational notes:
- KV cache eviction: Redwood confirms KV caches are cleared as part of the purge pipeline; cache eviction events are listed in the deletion certificate.
- If HelixCare requires a faster cert timeline (5 business days), add as commercial add-on to the order form.

If that language looks good Angela, Vanessa and I can prepare a final exhibit and a one-page commercial summary for procurement.

Regards,
